mapper.update: UPDATE system_state SET initialized_at = #{now} WHERE id = 1 AND initialized_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.nickname, u.avatar, u.administrator, c.password_hash AS passwordHash FROM app_user u JOIN auth_local_credential c ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE c.username = #{username}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_user (id, nickname, avatar, administrator, created_at) VALUES (#{user.id}, #{user.nickname}, #{user.avatar}, #{user.administrator}, #{now})
INSERT INTO auth_local_credential (username, password_hash, user_id, created_at) VALUES (#{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{userId}, #{now})
mapper.update: UPDATE app_user SET nickname = #{nickname}, avatar = #{avatar} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auth_session (token_hash, user_id, expires_at) VALUES (#{hash}, #{userId}, #{expires}) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET token_hash = EXCLUDED.token_hash, expires_at = EXCLUDED.expires_at
mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.nickname, u.administrator FROM app_user u JOIN auth_session s ON s.user_id = u.id WHERE s.token_hash = #{hash} AND s.expires_at > #{now}
SELECT id, nickname, avatar, administrator FROM app_user WHERE id = #{id}
